1 Year Warranty
1. Warranty period is judged by the serial number of products.Warranty of ASUS products starts from the date of invoice issued from the dealer. Customers are obliged to properly keep the purchase invoice (or proof of purchase) from the authorized dealer to protect their rights and share to ASUS as per request for warranty purpose. Asus has right to check the warranty based on customer invoice or activation date of the products. 2. For how to identify the warranty period of different ASUS products, please refer to the instruction on product serial number page. If you have purchased the warranty extension (not original ASUS warranty) from the authorized dealer, you need to contact with the dealer for warranty check during the warranty extension. 3. Warranty period and service process varies by different countries/regions. 4. Warranty period varies by different countries/regions. Please inquire with the local dealer where you purchase your product. 5. Damage and malfunction caused by the improper use and improper disassemble are not covered under the warranty. 6. ASUS Warranty service does not cover the damages resulted from the product disassembly by user or unauthorized service centres or Engineers, neither the incorrect disassembly/installation by user itself (excluding handheld products) 7. Customers removed the ASUS original warranty label without permission, warranty label is not inconsistent with product model/spec, serial number cannot be identified due to artificial obliteration and wear of the label, or products without ASUS serial number label attached. For all above cases , ASUS will cease the right of product warranty and repair service will not be provided. 8. If there is any damage caused to the ASUS parts by third-party components during the upgrade, the cost of replacing the damaged ASUS parts will not be covered under warranty. It will be the customer's responsibility; but the warranty still applies to the entire device.

    • Anurag
      5 out of 5 stars
      Great everyday work laptop
      Reviewed in India on 23 July 2026
      Colour: SilverConfiguration: Without Asus Care
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Been using this for a few months now for daily office work and it has been very reliable. The 16-inch screen makes a real difference when working on documents and spreadsheets, and it handles Office, a bunch of browser tabs and video calls at the same time without slowing down.

      Boot is quick and it wakes up instantly. Credits to the H series processor for this as well.

      Sound quality is decent. Build quality is decent as well.

      The keyboard is comfortable for long typing and silent. The backlit lighting is there but not a very clean look that you would expect, brightness and dullness here and there.

      Battery lasts a half a working day. Once again it’s the high-performance processor which drains the battery, despite optimization.

      Good value if you can snatch it with a nice bank discount and for anyone who mainly needs a solid machine for work.
